Garlicky Baked French Fried Potatoes
By: Kristi Rimkus
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 7:19am

Ingredients




8 large yukon gold potatoes, Sliced into 1/2″ pieces
1 tablespoon olive oil
3 cloves garlic, finely shredded
1/2 teaspoon salt

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 400. 2 Slice potatoes and dry on paper towel to remove moisture. 3 Toss fries with olive oil and salt. 4 Spread on a cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray. 5 Bake 20 – 30 minutes, turning to brown on all sides. Then 5 minutes before fries are tender, toss with shredded garlic. Bake another 5 minutes.

About


We live by a little restaurant in Snohomish that serves the most amazing garlic fries. Chef Chris at Mongo’s drowns his fries in shredded garlic, and serves them with an amazing jalepeno dip. I think I’ve died and gone to heaven!
As you can imagine, I don’t eat Chef’s fries as often as I’d like to, or my waistline would explode. Last night was burger night, so I decided to make a lighter version of Chef’s amazing garlic fries.
I must admit my fries were pretty darn good, and with considerably fewer calories and fat, I was a happy camper.
Happy cooking!
